source: real preview Cookie accounts, ephemeral Chromium contexts

manifest.cleanup: Only confirmed new QA fixtures: remove expenses, archive QA category/project, revoke QA key/invite, remove newly joined member.

checks.name: project_report_and_csv_actual_response
checks.csvMethod: UI export href fetched in browser memory; no download file saved

limitations: Stopped at the first failed prerequisite or assertion; no mutation retried.

Remote checks omit duplicate stale/archive writes, invitation-recovery replay, role downgrade, and Admin write replay to stay within 20 paced mutation attempts. Those edge cases have independent local/native evidence; Admin access is a read-only REST assertion.
Archived QA project and soft-deleted QA expenses retain ordinary accounting history/capacity; no raw SQL or business-history rewrites were used.

followUpDiagnosis.scope: Source-based runner diagnosis; no additional remote calls
followUpDiagnosis.cause: Owner Members page was retained after invitation creation. Recipient acceptance happened in a separate context. changeRole used the cached page without manual Reload, so newly joined member role controls were unavailable. No Editor PATCH was dispatched.
followUpDiagnosis.repair: Use explicit manual owner Reload and wait for its members response before role/removal controls; remaining role flow has a separate finite runner.
